_about: Stored reference results of this example (CON-15): the app's engine's runs, written by backend/tests/update_stored.py, explained in tests/golden/CHANGES.md.

creation.solver: the app's engine (new 0.1.0): variable step, rtol 1e-06, atol 1e-08; lap mode: the lap's speed profile, then fast mode along it in steps of at most 0.01 s; recorded every 1 s
creation.note: a sampled block tick a few ulps after an output point runs at its own time, the point showing it (the run no longer depends on its output grid): the hybrid back to its values before 46f78707
